687-3530-4613-5231-8130.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three additional counters of any kind on Tayam and/or additional creatures you control.
687-3530-4613-5231-8130.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Grim Initiate, adding mana.
When Grim Initiate dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate [[Tayam]] by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, milling three cards and returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability again, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter and a -0/-1 counter from the creature token and a vigilance counter from Grim Initiate.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Grim Initiate and the creature token, adding mana.
When Grim Initiate dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three cards and returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-3530-4613-5231-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

628-3899-7191.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2728-3967-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-3967-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-3967-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2103-4125-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1453-4050-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4050-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

57-2751-4846-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4846-7297.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6441-7296.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

628-997-7217.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

4772-5259-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4772-5259-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1183-4563-4853.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4563-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

uses.exileCardState: was foretold on a previous turn

3750-6102-6999.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-6102-6999.description:
Cast Sozin's Comet either from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}.
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ashling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
3750-6102-6999.notes: You can attack with multiple creatures to get infinite red mana.

1170-1329-1482-5223.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

985-2478-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
985-2478-2854-4574.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1456-3200-4195-4574.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

339-677-1879-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2919-4929-6805.description:
Activate Royal Herbalist by paying {2} and exiling a card from your library, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1350-4002-6747.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
You control at least four artifacts.
1350-4002-6747.description:
Cast Sceptre of Eternal Glory by paying {0} due to Sami.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory's second ability by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Sceptre of Eternal Glory from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1429-6792.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-1328-3499-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-3499-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

2557-3951-5703-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
2557-3951-5703-6646.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

325-392-1786-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-392-1786-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent loses 1 life.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

1486-4091-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-4091-5929.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

435-5145-5256-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

301-413-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-413-5643.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Putrid Goblin equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1516-3179-3613-4050.description:
Cast Devoted Grafkeeper from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {W}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as Departed Soulkeeper.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Warrior and Departed Soulkeeper, adding {W}{U}.
Departed Soulkeeper is not exiled due to Dress Down removing its ability.
Repeat.

609-1274-2060-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Mine Worker does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mine Worker.
609-1274-2060-3525.description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.

579-3793-4222-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
579-3793-4222-4720.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

238-3008-3705-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five additional nontoken creatures.
238-3008-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five additional nontoken creatures, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Cast Squee by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Squee.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing Squee to become a copy of Gerrard.
Put Squee in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Squee dies as a copy of Gerrard, it triggers, exiling itself and returning all other artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you have a sixth additional nontoken creature, sacrifice it as well each loop to get infinite colored mana.

678-2761-3581.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Glitterfang, adding {R}.
Glitterfang dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Glitterfang from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Glitterfang by paying {R}.
Repeat.

2510-3098-3449-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have a sorcery card exiled by Semblance Anvil.
2510-3098-3449-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

618-2160-2239-2647.manaNeeded: {R}{R} on your first turn, with {1}{R}{R} available on all subsequent turns
618-2160-2239-2647.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
The Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, returning Warrior's Oath from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Warrior's Oath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat each turn.

198-617-4235.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
198-617-4235.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
